Because the explicit overall SPSD count is present but absent from the candidate list, this requires manual review rather than selecting an incorrect candidate.
gold_master_row.predicted_categorisation_reason: This is an observational group study of a large cohort of patients with high-titre GAD65 antibodies, reporting aggregate clinical data. The paper provides original group-level data on SPS-spectrum patients, specifically identifying 107 with SPSD. There is no evidence of individual-level case descriptions, but the group-level data is robust and original.
